install_startup.recipe_modification_note: The project's own docker-compose.build.yml build genuinely fails (its Dockerfile references /scripts/-entrypoint.sh, which does not exist in the build context -- a real, disclosed bug in the app's own repo, not an environment issue). Separately, this session's own container cannot pull ANY Docker image at all: docker pull hello-world and docker pull flagsmith/flagsmith:latest (the exact image APP-001's own recipe_modification_note says worked in an earlier session on this same project) both fail identically with a 403 Forbidden at the CDN blob-download stage, for both Docker Hub and ghcr.io -- a real, reproducible difference from whatever session verified APP-001, not something fixable here. Given both the Dockerfile bug and the registry block, verified instead with a genuine native build: bun 1.3.11 + Node 24.20.0 (nvm) install, native Postgres 16 (schema pushed via the project's own `bun run --cwd packages/prisma db:push`), native Redis, and a local aiosmtpd catcher standing in for a real SMTP server so the app's own real email-code login flow could be driven end-to-end with a genuinely-received email rather than skipped. `apps/builder` run directly via `next dev` (bypassing `docker-compose.dev.yml`, which itself needs Postgres/MinIO/Redis images this sandbox also can't pull) after fixing two real environment-setup bugs found along the way: (1) `@typebot.io/react` needs an explicit `nx build` before `next dev` will resolve it when not going through the project's own `nx run-many` dev task; (2) `next-runtime-env` writes its browser env file relative to CWD, so running `next dev apps/builder` from the repo root wrote `public/__ENV.js` to the wrong directory -- fixed by running with `apps/builder` as the actual CWD (via `bun run --cwd apps/builder`) and colocating `.env` there. `apps/viewer`, `apps/workflows` and the PartyKit realtime server were not started -- out of scope for the builder-only verification done here.
install_startup.startup_command: bun run --cwd apps/builder next dev -p 8110 --hostname 0.0.0.0 (with a native Postgres DB pushed via the prisma package's own db:push script, and a local SMTP catcher standing in for outbound email)
